_comment: The Desktop step's curated app catalog (core/desktop_spec.py). Each app can be delivered NATIVE (an emerge atom, folded into --packages-add) or as a FLATPAK (an app id from a remote, installed at first boot by hugmesh-flatpak-apps). An empty atom or flatpak means that delivery is not offered. Whether a native atom resolves on this tree (keywords, USE) is what the step's emerge --pretend check is for; nothing here claims it. NATIVE_ARCHES / FLATPAK_ARCHES (Gentoo arch names; absent = every arch) record only a STRUCTURAL fact: the delivery does not exist for the other arches at all (a binary package with no arm64 keyword, a Flathub app built for x86_64 only), measured 2026-11-12. The Studio greys that delivery on such an image and refuses it with *_why. Keyword stability is never recorded here.

apps.label: Thunderbird
apps.native_why: thunderbird-bin is built for amd64 only
apps.flatpak_why: Flathub builds it for x86_64 only

apps.native_why: libreoffice-bin is built for amd64 only
